prompt: A straight documentary architectural photograph of a new seven-storey corner building at a street junction where tram tracks curve around the corner, taken standing on the pavement at eye height (about 1.6 m), three-quarter view looking along the curving tracks, verticals held straight, deep focus front to back, no wide-angle distortion. Light: hard midday sun from the left, each curved balcony throwing a sharp curved band of shadow across the terracotta below it, shadows of midday length. Clear blue sky. A straight documentary architectural photograph, matte natural colour, no gloss, no glow, no lens flare, no vignette, no colour grading, nobody looking at the camera.
